notes: Paper derives 95% CL upper limits on ALP-photon coupling g_agamma from polarimetric observations of Sagittarius A* by Event Horizon Telescope sub-array. Strongest constraints in mass range m_a ~ (10^-19 to 10^-18) eV. Data extracted from Figure 1 (main result). DM density assumed is 2×10^9 GeV/cm^3 from solitonic core + NFW profile. Best-fit parameters (m_a = 7.9×10^-18 eV, g_agamma = 3.2×10^-11 GeV^-1) already excluded by SN1987A and other constraints. Discontinuous jumps in constraint curve due to degeneracy between coupling and background position angle at low masses, and non-significant favored parameter space at high masses. Observation time ~4 hours with ~20 min cadence sensitive to m_a ~ 10^-18 eV. Paper uses solitonic core density profile appropriate for ultralight axion DM. | selector: text (sole candidate)
